hazards.evidence: Several orange-and-white medication bottles, small tubes, and loose items sit open and unsecured on the sink counter and toilet tank. A person with dementia could easily reach them and take too much or swallow the wrong item. No razor is clearly visible, but the medications alone make this hazard apply.

The white raised toilet seat sits on a white toilet in front of a white tub, with a light beige tile floor. The low contrast makes the seat hard to see and judge, which raises the risk of falls and toileting accidents.
